blocks.text: `gAi` is the optional cross-cutting Nodics backend group for AI capabilities. It is separate from `gFramework`, `gCore`, and `gExp` so a runtime activates AI only when required.

items: `aiAssistant`: conversation, client streaming, governed tools, conversation
`aiKnowledge`: corpus, ingestion, retrieval evidence, and citation contracts;
`aiProviders`: the sole provider-neutral gateway used by both capabilities.

blocks.text: No vendor provider is implemented yet. All AI capabilities remain disabled by default until an environment activates the group, activates the required modules, configures usage profiles, and supplies registered provider adapters.
